sentences.text: 2. Heard learned Counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri Ram Krishna Dubey, counsel for the informant.
Perused the record.

3. The instant bail application, under Section 439 Cr.P.C., has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicants on bail in Case Crime No. 288 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station- Faizganj Behta, District- Budaun during pendency of the trial.

sentences.text: Counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants have been falsely implicated in the instant case.
Neither the date and place nor the mode of payment of the alleged amount by the informant to the applicants has been disclosed in the first information report.
At the moment, there is no evidence to link the applicants with the offence.
It is further contended that no amount has been credited in the account of the applicants.
The applicants are not the beneficiary of the alleged transactions.
The applicants have not forged any documents.
The applicants do not have any criminal history and are in jail since 12.6.2023.
In case they are enlarged on bail, they will not misuse the said liberty.
5. Learned A.G.A. and counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

6. Having regard to the submissions made above and the fact that the applicants have remained confined for more than two months and after submission of the charge-sheet there is no hope of early conclusion of trial, more so when no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicants, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicants are entitled to be enlarged on bail.

7. Let the applicants, Makhan Lal @ Makhan Seth and Ankit involved in the aforesaid case be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned on the following conditions that:
i. the applicants shall not temper with the prosecution evidence; ii. the applicants shall not pressurize the prosecution witness; iii. the applicants shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
8.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 S.S.
